Slow-neighborhood calls such as Sunset/Parkside, Lakeshore and Outer Richmond often wait 800 to 1,100 s for an ambulance from downtown posts, while an idle paramedic engine is usually 200 to 400 s away. I added send_engine, which sends the fastest idle engine whenever it beats the ambulance by at least 45 s, skipping engines that are busy with their own fires in that hour.
